name: Nelson Mercer
life: “I still remember asking to train with a client who took longer.” On Friday, near the approach to Seabright Court, Nelson likes to watch the beach traffic thin enough for workers going the other way.
voice: I am the newest visitor. I asked for training time with the slow client rather than the tidy example house.
appearance: Nelson has a center part and straight chestnut hair, a deep crease beside the mouth when smiling, and a favorite piece of clothing, a narrow-striped sweater. It usually goes with a train token tied to a zipper pull. When somebody else has the floor, Nelson counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Nelson has a quick wit and an equally quick sense of shame. A joke is often Nelson's way of finding out whether a room is friendly enough for a serious question.
agenda: To learn the routine from the person who takes longest.
family: Warren Ito is Nelson’s older cousin. Nelson leaves the first voice message. Warren calls back when there is finally a little privacy. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *The other side of the cove*, Warren says, “I work in metal lettering. Both names fit if we give up the decorative crest.”
connections: Marcel Braun. The new visitor learns from a client whose best carer left after being asked to rush.

reactions.situation: A client wants another minute to finish a button
reactions.response: Nelson lets the client finish the button and asks where time can be saved without hurrying them.

reactions.situation: A power cut leaves two neighbors waiting on the stairs
reactions.response: Nelson asks which apartment is expecting someone home and makes sure that household knows about the delay.
reactions.asWritten: A power cut leaves two neighbors waiting on the stairs. Nelson asks which apartment is expecting someone home and makes sure that household knows about the delay.

reactions.response: Nelson seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
reactions.asWritten: If the joke lands badly, Nelson seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
